strings.instructions_body:
How to use HE SmartPhone Auto Clicker

1. Create a new setup or load a preset. No clicker runs until you enable a mode.
2. Allow display over other apps.
3. Turn on the accessibility service named HE SmartPhone Auto Clicker.
4. Tap ENABLE on one mode. A dark bar shows up on the left.

Presets
Save as preset stores the current setup.
If you loaded a preset, edit it then tap Update preset.
Close returns to the hub and stops the clicker.

Single target mode
One gold point. Drag it where you want the tap.
Tap the point to set the press duration and the time before the next tap.
Press play. Press the same button to pause.

Multi target mode
Press + to add a tap point.
Press the orange arrow to add a swipe. Two points show up. The line stays under the points.
Tap a point to set the press duration, or the swipe duration, and the time before the next action.
In Manage actions you can split targets into groups.
Main / Sequence groups run on play in order.
Random groups shuffle each cycle.
On demand groups wait for a manual Run from Manage or from the gear panel.
Press play. Auto groups run, then they start again.
Drag the move icon at the bottom of the bar to place the bar where you want.

Others
Common settings sets how many cycles run before stop. 0 means it keeps going until you pause.

The X closes the bar and turns the mode off.
